description: Enable an additional language for this brand's publishing set. Idempotent — enabling an already-enabled language is a no-op. This does NOT create a blog, run keyword research, or generate any pages — it is a settings write only. A new language starts as an empty publishing surface awaiting its own content (see seo_generate_keywords with `language`, and the landing-page translation tools, for the next steps). Fails if the brand is already at its plan's language cap (Trial/Growth 1, Pro 2, Enterprise 5) — tell the user they need to upgrade.

language.description: Language to enable, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs.

name: add_brand_language
